title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
problem: Given the heads of two singly linked-lists headA and headB, return the node at which the two lists intersect. If they do not intersect, return null.
constraints:
The number of nodes of listA is m, listB is n.
1 <= m, n <= 3 * 10^4
hints: If you traverse list A and then switch to list B's head, and vice-versa, the path lengths will equalize.
expected_approach: Dual pointer traversal with head swap on completion.
